stem:
Meera connects a small electric cell to make a torch bulb glow at home. She notices that one end of the cell has a raised metal cap and the other end is a flat metal disc.
Which statement about the cell is correct?

options.text: The flat metal disc is the positive terminal and the raised metal cap is the negative terminal; the cell pushes electric current around the circuit.
The raised metal cap is the positive terminal and the flat metal disc is the negative terminal; the cell supplies electrical energy to the circuit.
Either end of the cell can be the positive terminal, so the cell can be connected any way round to run the circuit.
Both ends of the cell are negative terminals; the cell stores electrical energy but cannot push current around a circuit.

teacher.key_rationale: An electric cell has two terminals: the raised metal cap is positive and the flat metal disc is negative; connected correctly it supplies electrical energy that drives current through the bulb. B states both facts correctly. A swaps the terminals, C ignores terminal identity, D claims both ends are negative.
